build_identity.desktop: Windows interactive RDP session (xfreerdp3 client), 1600x1000, 96 DPI unless stated

actions: Lab constraints 480x360..1400x1000: real corner drags; window.set limits/clears; invalid pairs; maximize/restore/minimize; focus observation; visible/focus/position/minimized set; hidden create; attention
expected: Constraints enforce and clear; observed state; attention
observed: Drags clamp to 480x360 / 1400x944 and to 600x400..900x700; clearing restores OS limits; invalid pairs -32602 and unchanged; observed maximized/minimized/position/focused correct; Windows implements visible/focus/position/minimized and hidden create (Wayland returns unsupported); attention acknowledged with presented:null
limitations: Dragging the bottom edge onto the screen edge triggers Windows vertical Aero Snap, which sized the client 7 px above the max height (OS snap rect); ordinary edge/corner drags clamp exactly
